name: Cislunar-Skerry
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near dust seas stretching to the horizon that no expedition has ever claimed.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
the quarantine zone changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants trade fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
